gloss: to mediate; to act as an intermediary; to broker

definitions.gloss: to mediate; to act as an intermediary; to broker
definitions.explanation: To act as a go-between to facilitate a deal, agreement, or resolution between two parties. Common in real estate, business, and diplomacy.

examples.japanese: {不動産|ふどうさん}を{仲介|ちゅうかい}する。
examples.english: To broker a real estate deal.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}が{二人|ふたり}の{間|あいだ}を{仲介|ちゅうかい}してくれた。
examples.english: A friend mediated between the two of them.

examples.japanese: この{取引|とりひき}は{専門|せんもん}の{業者|ぎょうしゃ}が{仲介|ちゅうかい}しているので{安心|あんしん}してください。
examples.english: A specialized broker is handling this transaction, so please rest assured.

notes:
Very commonly used in real estate ({不動産|ふどうさん}{仲介|ちゅうかい}) and business contexts. The noun form {仲介|ちゅうかい} is often used as a modifier meaning "intermediary" or "brokerage."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仲介|ちゅうかい}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}: broker, intermediary agent
- {仲介|ちゅうかい}{手数料|てすうりょう}: brokerage fee, commission
- {仲介|ちゅうかい}{役|やく}: mediator role
- {不動産|ふどうさん}{仲介|ちゅうかい}: real estate brokerage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {媒介|ばいかい}する: to mediate — more formal/technical, also used in science for disease transmission
- {調停|ちょうてい}する: to arbitrate — legal context, formal dispute resolution
- {取|と}り{持|も}つ: to mediate — more informal, acting as a go-between in personal relationships
